import re
from collections import Counter

def word_frequencies(k, paragraph):
    # Convert paragraph to lowercase and extract words
    words = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z]+", paragraph.lower())
    # Count frequency of each word

    most_common = frequency.most_common()
